config.rationale: Rounds 1-3 selected per-model settings using area 5161, seed 42 validation RMSE: full-day history for all models, Ridge alpha 10, LSTM width 16 and CNN width 16. A subsequent audit of the already evaluated 20-epoch study motivated raising the neural cap to 80 for all areas and seeds. This revision used stopping histories, not an optimization of test RMSE, but occurred after the original December 16-22 results were available. The revised results are a post-audit reevaluation on the same week, not a fresh untouched holdout. The small CNN validation improvement does not establish superiority.
